dog.description_text: Atom is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Atom, a six-year-old male, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/16bcMEwvR0k3oWmgKPQS06Imt8R1Vut9c/view?usp=drive_link His foster says, "At one week, he opened up a lot more. He was freely wandering and started to get vocal when he was hungry. Now, he’s fully opened up. He vocalizes to be pet often and sometimes will sleep with me on my bed as well. He’s super lovely and mostly loves to watch me do things. He’s also super curious!" Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
